title: EU announces establishment and composition of PreparEU Advisory Group on European Disaster Preparedness
content: European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission is establishing the PreparEU Advisory Group, tasked with providing strategic advice to President of the Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, and Commissioner for Equality; Preparedness and Crisis Management Hadja Lahbib on how to best address accelerating disaster risks, including extreme weather events and wildfires
